zh.title: 蓋特威克機場迎新航線 辛巴威航空開通哈拉雷直飛服務
zh.summary: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，辛巴威航空已開通由倫敦蓋特威克機場直飛哈拉雷的長途航線，該直飛航程營運時間約為十一小時。這項新服務的營運，進一步拓展了倫敦蓋特威克機場的非洲航線網路，為旅客提供最新的跨洲直飛選擇。
body: 根據媒體 Simple Flying 報導，辛巴威航空（Air Zimbabwe）已正式開通由倫敦蓋特威克機場（London Gatwick Airport）直飛哈拉雷（Harare）的全新長途航線。該航線的開通為往返英國與辛巴威之間的旅客提供了直飛選擇。
根據報導內容，這項全新開通的航線屬於跨洲長途飛行，單程直飛飛行時間長達十一小時。該服務展現了長途航線營運的最新發展。
此外，隨著辛巴威航空開啟哈拉雷直飛航線，倫敦蓋特威克機場的非洲航線網絡範圍也隨之進一步擴展。這項新航線也為蓋特威克機場的國際航線網路注入了新的營運網絡動能。

en.title: Air Zimbabwe Launches New Nonstop Long-Haul Flight Between London Gatwick and Harare
en.summary: According to media coverage by Simple Flying, Air Zimbabwe has launched new nonstop long-haul flights connecting London Gatwick Airport with Harare. The newly launched service operates direct long-distance flights between the two airports, establishing a regular transport link. The new route features an 11-hour flight duration, representing a significant addition to London Gatwick Airport's expanding African destination network. The introduction of these direct flights expands air connectivity options for travelers flying on the long-haul route between London Gatwick Airport and Harare.
body: According to a report by aviation news outlet Simple Flying, Air Zimbabwe has officially launched new nonstop long-haul flights connecting London Gatwick Airport with Harare. The new air route provides direct passenger service between the United Kingdom and Zimbabwe.

The nonstop service operates as an 11-hour long-haul flight between the two points. The new operation provides direct long-distance travel capabilities on the route connecting London Gatwick Airport and Harare.

With the introduction of this nonstop connection, London Gatwick Airport continues to see expansion in its African route network. The new Air Zimbabwe flight service enhances long-haul connectivity options available at London Gatwick Airport.

zh.title: 交通部民航局宣布8月1日起調高16處機場消防人員危險加給
zh.summary: 交通部民用航空局7月29日表示，行政院已核定調高機場消防人員危險職務加給，並訂於8月1日起生效。民航局所屬16處機場將區分為兩級，其中第一級每月支領9,700元，第二級每月支領7,760元。民航局指出，各機場均依國際民航組織（ICAO）標準配置專責消防人力。
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年7月29日宣布，為反映機場消防人員勤務之專業性與危險繁重現況，行政院已核定調高機場消防人員的危險職務加給，該項新方案將自8月1日起正式生效。
民航局表示，其所屬的16處機場將分為兩個層級。其中，第一級機場消防人員每月可支領9,700元加給，第二級機場消防人員每月則可支領7,760元加給。
民航局指出，全台各機場均為國家重要基礎設施，必須依據國際民航組織（ICAO）標準配置專責機場消防人力，以隨時因應各類突發狀況，確保營運與飛航安全。

en.title: Taiwan CAA to Raise Airport Firefighter Allowance Across 16 Airports from August 1
en.summary: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on July 29, 2026, that the Executive Yuan has approved an increase in hazardous duty allowances for airport firefighters, effective August 1. Under the approved plan, the CAA's 16 managed airports will be categorized into two tiers, with Tier 1 firefighters receiving NT$9,700 per month and Tier 2 receiving NT$7,760 per month. The CAA noted that dedicated airport firefighting personnel are deployed across Taiwan's airports in accordance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards to maintain flight safety and operational emergency response capabilities.
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced on July 29, 2026, that the Executive Yuan has approved an adjustment to increase the hazardous duty allowance for airport firefighting personnel, taking effect on August 1.

According to the CAA, its 16 administered airports will be classified into two tiers for the allowance scheme. Firefighters at Tier 1 airports will receive a monthly allowance of NT$9,700, while those at Tier 2 airports will receive NT$7,760 per month.

The agency stated that dedicated firefighting staff are deployed at airports across Taiwan in accordance with International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) standards to maintain flight safety and operational preparedness.
